## Menu entry and Continue Watching

- Preserve explicit menu-entry authorization across repeated content-parent focus notifications. Do not let deferred empty-menu callbacks revoke a pending request.
- Dismiss an inline preview when content explicitly requests the menu, then focus the current tab after the next frame. Keep fullscreen/manual trailer controls protected.
- Carry the exact episode ID represented by a Continue Watching card; choose it by latest activity rather than list order.
- Do not reuse an older series episode's retained stream simply because it belongs to the same series.
- Wait for refreshed resume state before automatic playback from cached details. Never pair a missing resume episode with the first episode's stream.

Signed 32-bit build. Physical-TV navigation and cross-device resume validation remains required.
